purpose: Decision-ready author-side English teaching assessment for five unresolved P1 cases plus independently detected P0 duplicate; no Master authorization or QA certification implied.

cases.semantic_reason: Definite article the selects contextually identifiable ingredients; it does not create a separate lexical sense of prep. Both frozen examples teach preparing ingredients.
cases.caveat: Confirm original Master senses and intended distinction before changing any learning queue.

cases.semantic_reason: turn off and switch off express the same notification-disabling action in this context; dialect/style preference is not an independent teaching sense.
cases.recommended_master_option: SELECT_SINGLE_PRIMARY_LEARNING_TARGET; retain secondary synonym in answer collocations if approved
cases.caveat: Do not merge source IDs without Master decision.

cases.semantic_reason: Empty a debris trap/container is not synonymous with clean a dishwasher filter; the latter already has a canonical KU. Previous suggestion to retarget to clean the dishwasher filter is superseded by verified collision.
cases.recommended_master_option: REQUIRE_SOURCE_PHYSICAL_OBJECT_AND_ACTION_EVIDENCE; if unsupported HOLD or suppress separately; do not rename into KU01825
cases.caveat: No assumption that every filter can meaningfully be emptied.

cases.semantic_reason: Warm up dinner is idiomatic, but the modifier late dinner does not introduce a new reheating meaning; existing reheat dinner example expressly covers late return.
cases.caveat: Do not auto-replace expression and accidentally duplicate another KU.

cases.semantic_reason: Standalone target has unclear object/recipient; natural construction is 'squirt some dish soap onto the sponge' or 'squirt a little dish soap onto the sponge'.

proposed_answer_only.expression: squirt dish soap onto a sponge
proposed_answer_only.example_en: Squirt a little dish soap onto the sponge before washing the pan.
proposed_answer_only.example_zh: 洗锅前往海绵上挤一点洗洁精。

cases.caveat: Proposed answer is editorial candidate, not integrated or certified.

cases.semantic_reason: Spin failure can denote malfunction of a washer's spin function, but it is less natural as a standalone everyday learning target than 'the washer won't spin'. Neither spin cycle nor drainage problem has the same meaning.

proposed_answer_only_if_technical_sense_.example_en: The technician diagnosed a spin failure in the washing machine.
proposed_answer_only_if_technical_sense_.example_zh: 维修人员诊断洗衣机的脱水功能发生了故障。

cases.recommended_master_option: AUTHORIZE_TECHNICAL_CONTEXT_OR_HOLD; never classify distinct existing spin-cycle and drainage KUs as duplicates
cases.caveat: Source meaning and original Master Sense must be checked.
